mainEntity.name: How do I build a persona from customer reviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paste an AliExpress, Amazon or Shopify product link into the tool and run the analysis. It reads the public reviews, spots motivations, pain points, the people mentioned and usage contexts, then pulls them into a buyer profile you can copy.

AliExpress, Amazon (the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and other marketplaces) and Shopify stores using Judge.me, Okendo, Yotpo, Stamped or Loox. Otherwise, the tool reads the reviews declared in the page code.

mainEntity.name: Why does the Amazon analysis cover so few reviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you’re not signed in, Amazon only shows a sample of reviews on the product page. The tool adds to that sample with the aspects Amazon calculates across all reviews, such as the share of positive reviews on quality or battery life.

mainEntity.name: Why are no reviews found on my Shopify store?

acceptedAnswer.text: The store may not display reviews, or it may use a review app the tool doesn’t read yet. Also check that the link points to a product page, with /products/ in the URL.
No. The tool spots themes with keyword lists in five languages and reads each review in its own language. The result is the same every time, and every line points back to real reviews.

mainEntity.name: How many reviews does the tool analyze?

acceptedAnswer.text: Up to a few hundred depending on the platform. On AliExpress, it adds the 1, 2 and 3 star reviews, often buried under positive ones, so pain points stand out.

mainEntity.name: How do I use the persona for my ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treat each strong motivation as an angle to test and reuse the customers’ exact words in the hook. Pain points help you prepare the answers on your product page and in your FAQ.
Yes, free and no account needed. Reviews are read on demand from public pages and nothing is stored on our side.

@graph.name: Build a persona from customer reviews

step.name: Pick a product
step.text: Open a product page on AliExpress, Amazon or a Shopify store, ideally a product that already has plenty of reviews.

step.name: Copy its link
step.text: Copy the full product page URL: aliexpress.com/item/…, amazon.com/dp/… or …/products/… for a Shopify store.

step.name: Run the analysis
step.text: Paste the link into the tool and run the analysis. The persona, motivations, pain points and quotes show up in a few seconds.
